# Ignite UI for Web Components Dashboards v7.1.1 — Full API Reference

> Complete API reference for the Ignite UI for Web Components Dashboards package (7.1.1). This file lists all public classes, interfaces, enumerations, type aliases, functions, and variables with their signatures, parameters, and descriptions.

Platform: Web Components
Package: igniteui-webcomponents-dashboards
Version: 7.1.1

## Classes

### [IgcDashboardTileChangingContentEventArgs](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents-dashboards/7.1.0/classes/IgcDashboardTileChangingContentEventArgs)

- **constructor**(): IgcDashboardTileChangingContentEventArgs
- **contentJson**: `string`

### [IgcDashboardTileComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents-dashboards/7.1.0/classes/IgcDashboardTileComponent)
Testing exports for the tile: the display list of what it is showing, and the
state that is not in that display list.
The tile is a wrapper in the same sense a DomainChart is: it does not draw, it
resolves a description tree and lets the renderer build a chart, a pie, a gauge or
a map, then hosts the result. So it reports itself the way DomainChart does --
ExportSerializedVisualData forwards to whatever is currently displayed, and the
state that was never drawn travels on a side channel next to it.
The side channel matters more here than it does for a chart. A host can reach a
DomainChart's sub chart through ExportDomainChartTestingInfo and walk it; the
tile's MainContent is private and its type is not known until the data has been
inspected, so there is nothing a host can usefully hold. Everything it needs to
know -- which component it got, what the tile resolved -- has to be stated, and
stating it as data is what lets the same export serve a host in another process.
What is deliberately NOT here: anything the display list already carries. The
visual data stays a display list so tests assert on what the tile actually drew,
not on the configuration it drew from.

- **constructor**(): IgcDashboardTileComponent
- static **htmlTagName**: `string`
- **actualBrushes**: `string[]` — Gets the actual palette of brushes to use for coloring the chart series.
- **actualCustomizations**: `IgcDashboardTileCustomizationComponent[]`
- **actualOutlines**: `string[]` — Gets the actual palette of brushes to use for outlines on the chart series.
- **autoCalloutsVisible**: `boolean` — Gets or sets if the auto value callouts should be displayed.
- **backgroundColor**: `string` — Gets or sets the color to use for the background of the component.
- **baseTheme**: `BaseControlTheme` — Gets or sets the base built in theme to use for the checkbox.
- **brushes**: `string[]` — Gets or sets the palette of brushes to use for coloring the dashboard tile.
The value provided should be an array of CSS color strings or JavaScript objects defining gradients. Optionally the first element can be a string reading "RGB" or "HSV" to specify the interpolation mode of the collection
- **categoryAxisMajorStroke**: `string` — Gets the brush to use for the Category axis major strokes, if applicable.
- **changingContent**: `any`
- **contentCustomizations**: `IgcDashboardTileCustomizationComponent[]`
- **crosshairsAnnotationEnabled**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether annotations are shown along the axis for crosshair values
- **crosshairsDisplayMode**: `CrosshairsDisplayMode` — Gets or sets the crosshairs to be displayed.
- **customizations**: `IgcDashboardTileCustomizationCollection` — Gets a collection where you can add customization that will be applied to the generated visualizations.
- **dataSource**: `any` — Gets or sets a collection of data items used to generate the dashboard tile.
The ItemsSource of this dashboard tile can be a list of objects containing one or more numeric properties.
Additionally, if the objects in the list implement an enumerable interface,
the dashboard tile will attempt to delve into the sub-collections when reading through the data source.
Data binding can be further configured by attributing the data item classes
with the data intent feature.
- **density**: `ControlDisplayDensity` — Gets or sets the display density to use for the toolbar.
- **excludedProperties**: `string[]` — Gets or sets a set of property paths that should be excluded from consideration by the category chart.
- **filterExpressions**: `IgcFilterExpressionCollection` — Gets the current filter that is applied to the chart. Collection can be updated to modify the filter for the chart. Once filter expressions are in this collection, the chart will no longer listen for changes on their properties.
- **filterStringErrorsParsing**: `any`
- **finalValueAnnotationsVisible**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether annotations for the final value of each series is displayed on the axis.
- **groupDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection` — Gets the current grouping that is applied to the grid. Collection can be updated to modify the grouping for the grid. Once grouping descriptions are in this collection, the grid will no longer listen for changes on their properties.
- **groupSortDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection`
- **groupSorts**: `string` — Gets or sets the sorts to apply after grouping has been applied.
- **height**: `string`
- **highlightedDataSource**: `any` — Gets or sets a collection of data items used to generate the dashboard tile.
The HighlightedItemsSource of this dashboard tile can be a list of objects containing one or more numeric properties.
Additionally, if the objects in the list implement an enumerable interface,
the dashboard tile will attempt to delve into the sub-collections when reading through the data source.
Data binding can be further configured by attributing the data item classes
with the data intent feature.
- **highlightedValuesDisplayMode**: `SeriesHighlightedValuesDisplayMode` — Gets or sets whether and how to display highlighted values for the series. Note, this is distinct from the highlighting feature that indicates what is closest or under the mouse.
This property applies to Category Chart and Financial Chart controls.
- **highlightFilterExpressions**: `IgcFilterExpressionCollection` — Gets the current highlight filter that is applied to the chart. Collection can be updated to modify the highlight filter for the chart. Once filter expressions are in this collection, the chart will no longer listen for changes on their properties.
- **includedProperties**: `string[]` — Gets or sets a set of property paths that should be included for consideration by the category chart, leaving the remainder excluded. If null, all properties will be considered.
- **initialFilter**: `string` — Gets or sets the filter to apply to the chart. This property will become ignored if the filter is changed outside of this property.
- **initialFilterExpressions**: `IgcFilterExpressionCollection` — Gets the initial filters that are applied to the chart.
- **initialGroupDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection` — Gets the initial groupings that are applied to the chart.
- **initialGroups**: `string` — Gets or sets the groupings to apply to the chart. This property will become ignored if sorts are changed outside of this property.
- **initialGroupSortDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection` — Gets the initial sorts that are applied to the chart after groupings and summaries are applied.
- **initialHighlightFilter**: `string` — Gets or sets the filter to apply to the chart. This property will become ignored if the filter is changed outside of this property.
- **initialHighlightFilterExpressions**: `IgcFilterExpressionCollection` — Gets the initial highlight filters that are applied to the chart.
- **initialSortDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection` — Gets the initial sorts that are applied to the chart.
- **initialSorts**: `string` — Gets or sets the sorts to apply to the chart. This property will become ignored if sorts are changed outside of this property.
- **initialSummaries**: `string` — Gets or sets the summaries to apply to the chart. This property will become ignored if sorts are changed outside of this property.
- **initialSummaryDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSummaryDescriptionCollection` — Gets the initial summaries that are applied to the chart.
- **isUserAnnotationsEnabled**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether initiating user annotations from the toolbar is enabled.
- **isVisTypeRadial**: `boolean`
- **isVisTypeStacked**: `boolean`
- **noDataMessage**: `string` — Gets or sets the text the tile shows in place of its content when it has no data.
Left unset, the tile shows a localized message. Set to an empty string, the tile
shows nothing at all where its content would be.
- **outlines**: `string[]` — Gets or sets the palette of brushes to use for outlines on the dashboard tile.
The value provided should be an array of CSS color strings or JavaScript objects defining gradients. Optionally the first element can be a string reading "RGB" or "HSV" to specify the interpolation mode of the collection
- **reinferenceRules**: `IgcDataSeriesAdapterReinferenceRuleCollection` — Gets the rules for when a change to the items of the data should make the tile analyze
the data again, and so possibly choose differently what to show. A change to the data's
schema, a reset, or the data being replaced always does; these decide the rest.
- **selectedSeriesItems**: `IgcChartSelectedItemCollection` — Gets the currently selected data items.  Adding or removing data items from this collection will
select or deselect the visuals associated with those items.
- **selectedSeriesItemsChanged**: `any` — Raised when the SelectedSeriesItems collection has changed.
- **settingsLoadErrors**: `any` — Raised when LoadSettingsFromJson finds settings it cannot load.
- **shouldAvoidAxisAnnotationCollisions**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether annotations for the final value of each series is displayed on the axis.
- **shouldDisplayMockData**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether the dashboard tile should display mock data when the data source has not been provided, if supported for this type of chart.
- **shouldUseSkeletonStyleForMockData**: `boolean` — Gets or sets whether the dashboard tile should use a faded skeleton style for mock data.
- **simulateInputCompleted**: `any` — Raised when input delegated into an area has finished its asynchronous work.
Required by ISimulateInputTarget so that a tile can itself be a child of another
simulate-input walk, and so the tracker below has an owner to raise completion
on once the area it delegated to reports back.
- **sortDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSortDescriptionCollection` — Gets the current sort that is applied to the grid. Collection can be updated to modify the sort for the grid. Once sort descriptions are in this collection, the grid will no longer listen for changes on their properties.
- **summaryDescriptions**: `IgcDashboardTileSummaryDescriptionCollection` — Gets the current summaries that are applied to the grid.
- **tileTitle**: `string` — Gets or sets text to display above the plot area.
- **trendLineBrushes**: `string[]` — Gets or sets the palette of brushes to used for coloring trend lines in this chart.
The value provided should be an array of CSS color strings or JavaScript objects defining gradients. Optionally the first element can be a string reading "RGB" or "HSV" to specify the interpolation mode of the collection
- **trendLineType**: `TrendLineType` — Gets or sets the formula used for calculating trend lines in this chart.
This property applies only to these chart types: point, line, spline, and bubble
- **trendLineTypes**: `IgcTrendLineTypeCollection` — Gets or sets what trendlines to use in the chart.
- **userAnnotationInformationRequested**: `any` — Occurs to request additional information for an annotation being added.
- **userAnnotationToolTipContentUpdating**: `any` — Occurs to request additional information for an annotation being added.
- **validVisualizationTypePriorityThreshold**: `number` — Gets or sets the crosshairs to be displayed.
- **validVisualizationTypes**: `DashboardTileVisualizationType[]` — Gets the current set of valid visualization types for the data.
- **valueLines**: `IgcValueModeCollection` — Gets or sets what value lines to use in the chart.
- **valueLinesBrushes**: `string[]` — Gets or sets the palette of brushes to use for coloring the value lines present in the ValueLines property.
The value provided should be an array of CSS color strings or JavaScript objects defining gradients. Optionally the first element can be a string reading "RGB" or "HSV" to specify the interpolation mode of the collection
- **valueLinesGlobalAverageBrush**: `string` — Gets or sets the color for GlobalAverage value lines.
- **valueLinesGlobalMaximumBrush**: `string` — Gets or sets the color for GlobalMaximum value lines.
- **valueLinesGlobalMinimumBrush**: `string` — Gets or sets the color for GlobalMinimum value lines.
- **visualizationType**: `DashboardTileVisualizationType` — Gets or sets the crosshairs to be displayed.
- **width**: `string`
- static **observedAttributes**: `string[]`
- **addCommandAvailabilityListener**(listener: ICommandAvailabilityListener): void
- **addCommandStateChangedListener**(listener: ICommandStateChangedListener): void
- **afterContentInit**(): void
- **attributeChangedCallback**(name: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string): void
- **cancelAnnotationFlow**(annotationFlowId: string): void
- **clearSettings**(): void
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **destroy**(): void
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void
- **exportSerializedAdditionalState**(): string — Export the state of the tile's areas that is not in their display lists.
The same envelope shape as ExportSerializedVisualData, keyed by the same area
names, so a reader joins the two halves of an area by looking the name up in
both rather than by knowing which fields belong to which region.
The tile's own resolved state is an area like any other. It has no display list
-- the visualization it chose and the set it considered are not drawn, and no
amount of looking at rendered output recovers a rejected candidate -- so it
appears here and not next door, which is exactly the distinction the two
exports draw.
An area contributes nothing when it has no state that was not drawn, and is
then left out. A gauge, a map, a legend and a grid are all in that position
today: what a test asks of them is drawn, so it is in the display list already.
- **exportSerializedVisualData**(): string — Export the display lists of the tile's areas, keyed by area name.
Each area states its own type next to its payload, because a display list has
no self-describing header and the type is what tells a reader which parser the
payload wants. The payload is the component's own serialized visual data,
embedded as-is: a tile-shaped wrapper around it would mean every existing
analyzer needed a tile-aware variant to see through.
Adding an area is adding a name above and a line below. Toolbar and editor areas
are included only while their resolved components are available (and, for the
editor, visible), just like the content, legend and grid areas.
- **findByName**(name: string): any
- **finishAnnotationFlow**(flowInformation: IgcUserAnnotationInformation): void
- **getDesiredToolbarActions**(): ToolActionInfo[]
- **getSettingsLoadErrors**(): string[] — The problems the last LoadSettingsFromJson found, or none when it loaded everything.
- **getSettingsValue**(key: string): IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent
- **hasModifiedSettings**(): boolean
- **loadAnnotationsFromJson**(jsonString: string): void
- **loadSettingsFromJson**(jsonString: string): void — Replaces the tile's settings with ones SaveSettingsToJson gave.
Loads as much as it can rather than throwing: a setting that cannot be read is skipped
and the rest are loaded, and JSON that cannot be read at all leaves the settings as they
were. Each problem is kept, readable from GetSettingsLoadErrors, and reported through
SettingsLoadErrors.
- **notifyClearItems**(source_: any): void — Used to manually notify the tile that the data source has reset or cleared its items.
- **notifyContainerResized**(): void
- **notifyInsertItem**(source_: any, index: number, newItem: any): void
- **notifyRemoveItem**(source_: any, index: number, oldItem: any): void
- **notifySetItem**(source_: any, index: number, oldItem: any, newItem: any): void
- **onUIReady**(): void
- **removeCommandAvailabilityListener**(listener: ICommandAvailabilityListener): void
- **removeCommandStateChangedListener**(listener: ICommandStateChangedListener): void
- **removeSettingsValue**(key: string): void
- **requestReinference**(): void — Analyzes the data again now, whatever the reinference rules would say.
- **resetAnnotations**(): void
- **resetZoom**(): void — Resets the zoom level to default.
- **saveAnnotationsToJson**(): string
- **saveSettingsToJson**(): string — The tile's settings, including what its editor did to the content's collections, as
JSON to keep and give back to LoadSettingsFromJson.
- **scaleAxisValue**(axisName: string, value: number): number
- **scaleXAxisValue**(value: number): number — Scales a value on the first horizontal axis of the content the tile is displaying.
- **scaleYAxisValue**(value: number): number — Scales a value on the first vertical axis of the content the tile is displaying.
- **simulateInput**(type: any, elementPath: string[], localX: number, localY: number, data: string[], id: string): IgcSimulateInputResult
- **startCreatingAnnotation**(): void
- **startDeletingAnnotation**(): void
- **unscaleAxisValue**(axisName: string, value: number): number
- **unscaleXAxisValue**(value: number): number — Unscales a pixel position on the first horizontal axis of the content the tile is displaying.
- **unscaleYAxisValue**(value: number): number — Unscales a pixel position on the first vertical axis of the content the tile is displaying.
- **updateSettingsValue**(key: string, value: IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent): void
- **updateStyle**(): void
- **zoomIn**(percentage: number): void
- **zoomOut**(percentage: number): void — Performs zoom out action on the chart by specified percentage of current window rect
- static **_createFromInternal**(internal: any): IgcDashboardTileComponent
- static **register**(): void

### [IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents-dashboards/7.1.0/classes/IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent)
A value kept in a dashboard tile's settings. It holds one typed value, or a list of
nested values: a list whose values have keys is a bag of named values, and one whose
values have none is an array.

- **constructor**(): IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent
- static **htmlTagName**: `string`
- **boolValue**: `boolean`
- **brushValue**: `string`
- **doubleValue**: `number`
- **intValue**: `number`
- **key**: `string` — The value's name, when it is one of the values of a bag.
- **objectValue**: `any`
- **stringValue**: `string`
- **values**: `IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueCollection` — The nested values, when this holds a bag or an array.
- **valueType**: `DashboardTileSettingsValueType` — Which of the typed values this holds. Setting one of them sets this.
- static **observedAttributes**: `string[]`
- **attributeChangedCallback**(name: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string): void
- **connectedCallback**(): void
- **disconnectedCallback**(): void
- **findByName**(name: string): any
- static **_createFromInternal**(internal: any): IgcDashboardTileSettingsValueComponent
- static **register**(): void

## Enumerations

### [DashboardTileSettingsValueType](https://www.infragistics.com/api/webcomponents/igniteui-webcomponents-dashboards/7.1.0/enums/DashboardTileSettingsValueType)
Which of a settings value's typed values it holds.

- **Brush** = 5
- **double1** = 2
- **Int** = 3
- **None** = 0
- **object1** = 6
- **string1** = 1
- **Values** = 7
